summary: Implemented total=None support for Progress tasks and ProgressBar, which now render a pulse animation when the total is unknown. Changes are in rich/progress.py, rich/progress_bar.py, tests/test_progress.py (new test test_bar_columns_with_unknown_total), and CHANGELOG.md. The progress tests pass (37/37). The full suite has 13 failures that also occur on the untouched baseline (same set, compared before and after), and tests/test_pretty.py cannot be collected because the shared venv lacks the attr package; I did not install it. Nothing was committed.
